name: ticketmastery-api
description: TicketMastery backend API (ECS Fargate service): concerts, organiser management, seat inventory.

scripts.test:coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('coverage', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit false --outDir coverage/build && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.cpSync('migrations', 'coverage/build/migrations', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('package.json', 'coverage/build/package.json')" && c8 node --test --test-concurrency=1 coverage/build/test/*.test.js
